description:
Configure the email receipt settings in Copper Point of Sale for 'City Lights Bookstore'.

1. Open Copper Point of Sale and navigate to the Options/Preferences menu.
2. Locate the 'Web/Email' or 'SMTP' settings section.
3. Configure the following SMTP settings exactly:
   - SMTP Host: smtp.sendgrid.net
   - Port: 587
   - Secure Connection: Yes (SSL/TLS/STARTTLS)
   - Authentication: Enabled
   - Username: apikey
   - Password: SG.RetailAgent.Verify123!
   - Sender Email: receipts@citylightsbooks.com
   - Reply-To Email: manager@citylightsbooks.com
4. Set the email subject template to: 'Your City Lights Bookstore Receipt'
5. Save the settings.
